calculation.description: Ranks recent five-session underperformers, using stronger reversal exposure when the observation-only VIX is rising and dampening the signal when VIX is not rising. All inputs are lagged/completed daily bars; VIX is macro observation only and is never traded.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in every calendar year: 2020 0.056635, 2021 0.050356, 2022 0.118517, 2023 0.026484, 2024 0.082265, 2025 0.012267, 2026 0.042756. Small 15-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation. The high correlation to simple five-day reversal indicates substantial redundancy and should be audited by the deterministic post-Miner gate.
